entries.what: Walked to Flats High on Vinca for first through sixth period. At lunch in room B12, Karina mentioned the Thanksgiving food drive and Dulce signed up to bag groceries at Our Lady of the Marsh on Nov 22, 8-11 a.m.
entries.outcome: Signed up for the food drive before checking her calendar.

entries.what: In third-period chemistry with Ms. Tolentino she did the stoichiometry math fast and skipped the writing part.
entries.outcome: Wrote down a reminder about the lab writeup.

entries.what: At home in unit 114 she worked out how to fit the food drive around her Sunday shift and the Tuesday/Thursday chem study sessions at the library. Yesenia got home from her St. Anselm shift around 3:30.
entries.outcome: Decided the drive morning works if she is done by 11.

entries.what: Veterans Day, so school was closed. She slept in, then did homework at the kitchen table.
entries.outcome: Got geometry done.

entries.what: Walked to Delgado Park with Yesenia for the end of the Veterans Day ceremony at the bandstand and picked up a snack.
entries.outcome: Short, pleasant outing.

entries.what: Texted Karina and Eli in the lab rats chat while Spanish project notes sat open on her phone.
entries.outcome: Planned to write up the interview soon.

entries.what: School day. At the library homework center after school she worked on the Spanish family-history project, due Friday. The interview with Tía Gladys about the stand was already recorded, but she couldn't turn the notes into paragraphs.
entries.outcome: Got a rough outline but no paragraphs.

entries.what: Back home, she worked on the project with the interview notes and finished two paragraphs. She counted her phone fund out loud to double-check it.
entries.outcome: Two paragraphs done, more to go.

entries.what: Went to bed around 11:30.
entries.outcome: Asleep on time.

entries.what: The first fall storm brought heavy rain. She walked to school under a hoodie and arrived soaked, with a cracked phone that died by 2 p.m.
entries.outcome: Spent the afternoon without a working phone.

entries.what: Library homework center chem catch-up session from 3:30 to 5 with Karina, mostly on the lab conclusion.
entries.outcome: Finished the writeup draft.

entries.what: Folded to-go boxes at the family pupusa stand on Thursday evening in the drizzle. Gladys and Rafael were there, and Oscar was happy with the crowd.
entries.outcome: Stand stayed busy despite the storm.

entries.what: Turned in the Spanish family-history project in sixth period.
entries.outcome: Submitted on time.

entries.what: At Taquería Colima Friday 4-9, tickets ran slow in the rain rush, so she asked Camila and Héctor how to learn the Spanish names for every menu item and not slow down the line. She had been on time and was not looking to dodge shifts.
entries.outcome: Planned to study a menu cheat sheet.

entries.what: Counted the drawer at close, then Rafael picked her up at 9 and drove her home.
entries.outcome: Drawer matched to the penny.

entries.what: Morning at the card-only laundry room for Saturday laundry. She got her paycheck money together, then asked the assistant for a used-phone buying checklist.
entries.outcome: Had a checklist to bring to the shop.

entries.what: Bought a used phone for $210 from the Plaza Marisol repair shop with a mint green case, paying entirely from her own savings with no boba spending.
entries.outcome: Phone goal met.

entries.what: Sent Yesenia a photo of the new phone with a note that she paid for it herself.
entries.outcome: Yesenia was proud.

entries.what: Sunday shift at Taquería Colima from 10 to 4, using the new phone only on breaks since Efraín allows no phones behind the counter.
entries.outcome: Smooth shift.

entries.what: Evening at home setting up the new phone and moving contacts, with plans for the food drive.
entries.outcome: Phone ready.

entries.what: Karina texted after midnight asking if people were talking about her. Dulce answered from the new phone.
entries.outcome: Reassured her and went to sleep late.
